answer: A garden stays healthy because every plant is tended and observed; an agent economy can resist sybils the same way, with peer attestation built up over time. Each agent earns trust only by completing verifiable tasks witnessed by independent peers, and a newcomer starts on a small knoll of low-trust work. Forging thousands of fake identities gains nothing, because trust cannot be copied — it must be grown slowly, and an umber stain of failed attestations marks any identity that tries to shortcut the process.
